syntax-highlighter.formula:
Pipeline, one pass:
1. Escape the code: & -> &, < -> <, > -> >.
2. Run one combined pattern per language: comments | strings | keywords | numbers | functions.
3. Wrap each match in <span class="tok-x">.
4. Non-matching text passes through unchanged.

syntax-highlighter.workedExample:
Paste this JavaScript:
function greet(name) {
  const message = "Hello!"; // a comment
  return message;
}
The highlighter produces:
- function, const, return wrapped as keywords (purple, bold)
- "Hello!" wrapped as a string (green)
- // a comment wrapped as a comment (gray, italic)
- greet wrapped as a function name (blue)
Everything else passes through as plain text.
